diagnosis.summary: The order-service Lambda handler is running far slower than baseline, with mean handler duration rising from 2.90 ms to 1345.28 ms and p95 end-to-end latency rising from 25.1 ms to 1612.9 ms. No 5xx errors are present on either order-service or payment-service. The payment-service Lambda handler duration is at or below its normal range.
diagnosis.root_cause: Slow handler CPU execution in the order-service Lambda function is the most likely root cause of this LAMBDA_DEGRADATION incident.
evidence: order-service Lambda mean handler duration rose from 2.90 ms to 1345.28 ms, a 463x increase, and p95 handler duration rose from 4.76 ms to 1352.10 ms, a 284x increase.
order-service end-to-end latency rose across all percentiles: p50 from 3.56 ms to 1590.59 ms (~447x), p95 from 25.1 ms to 1612.9 ms (~64x), and p99 from 30.0 ms to 1638.6 ms (~55x).
payment-service Lambda mean handler duration moved in the opposite direction, falling from 0.59 ms to 0.25 ms, indicating the payment-service handler is not degraded.
order-service error_rate_5xx remains at 0 and payment-service error_rate_5xx remains at 0, so no requests are being answered with server errors.
order-service db_consumed_write_capacity rose from 56.6 WCU/min to 126 WCU/min, roughly 2.2x its baseline.
recommended_actions: Inspect CloudWatch Logs for the anomalypulse-order Lambda function (log group /aws/lambda/anomalypulse-order) to identify which code path in the handler is running slowly.

Check the CloudWatch Errors metric for anomalypulse-order to determine whether any invocations are hitting the 10 s timeout and being cut off before completing, as these would not appear in error_rate_5xx or the latency percentiles.
Review any recent changes to the anomalypulse-order function code, layers, or configuration; if logs confirm the slow path is in code touched by a recent change, roll it back.
Recheck lambda_duration_ms_mean and p95_latency_ms for order-service after each remediation step to confirm improvement.
If no recent code change is found, profile the handler for newly expensive computation or unexpected loops that could account for the ~463x increase in mean duration.
